data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 1,128.632m. The Syndicate reported a favourable prior year contribution of GBP 14.292m (net), driven by better than expected prior year development in Employers' Liability and Public Liability (long-tail disease) and influenced by reinsurance commutations at year end. No gross prior-year reserve movement (insurance liabilities) was disclosed; the stated prior year contribution is a net figure.
raw_causal_phrases: better than expected prior year development from within the Employers Liability and Public Liability classes, including a separate analysis of long-tail disease claims.

On 31 December 2015, the Syndicate commuted two reinsurance treaty contracts: GBP 9 million xs GBP 1 million (2008-2010) and; $13 million xs $2 million (2011-2013) based on the discounted value of the reinsurance asset held on the balance sheet.
The overall resultant benefit was a GBP 14,292,000 prior year contribution to the result (2014 GBP 23,233,000 adverse) on an annual accounting basis.
data.data_quality_notes: No gross (insurance liabilities) prior year movement note was found. The report explicitly states a prior year contribution of GBP 14,292k but this appears to be a NET figure (after reinsurance). A gross PYD amount was not disclosed; the claims development table provided is a NET triangle. The prior_year_development_gbp_m therefore uses the reported NET prior year contribution and is flagged as net-derived.
